hero.headline_template: {city_name} is mapped on an H3 grid at resolution {h3_res}. {viable_count} viable cells carry balanced opportunity scores; demographics use density × income index, not population alone.

cards.question: Where is demand strongest on the grid?
cards.headline_template: Top demographics percentile sits in {area} ({score} on the city scale).
cards.footnote: Demographics pillar uses density × income index at cell level.
cards.number_tooltip: Normalized city percentile for the demographics composite on the highest cell.
cards.as_of_tooltip: INSEE IRIS 2021 population density and Filosofi 2021 income index.

cards.question: How strong is balanced opportunity city-wide?
cards.headline_template: Median balanced score is {median}; strongest pillar on average is {pillar}. Peak cell: {peak_area} ({peak_score}).
cards.footnote: Balanced weights: demographics 35%, competitive 25%, digital 15%, foot traffic 15%, financial 10%.
cards.caveat: Scores compare cells within this city only, not a site recommendation.
cards.number_tooltip: 50th percentile of opportunity_score across viable cells.
cards.as_of_tooltip: Mixed INSEE, OSM, and model pillars, see Data sources for field lineage.

cards.question: How rich is the food-supply landscape?
cards.headline_template: {venues} active food venues roll up to {groups} cuisine groups across {viable} viable cells.
cards.footnote: Market Watch matrix is offline-built from OpenStreetMap venues.
cards.caveat: LQ and gap views exclude low tag-coverage cells, read the panel note when present.
cards.number_tooltip: Counted in the Market Watch matrix build for this city.
cards.as_of_tooltip: OSM Overpass refresh; matrix warmed at server start.

cards.question: How does your portfolio sit on the grid?
cards.headline_template: {locations} portfolio pins in {city_name}; {locations_all} across all seeded cities. Inspect lineage in Data.
cards.caveat: Pin-level demographics can differ from hex aggregates on the same street.
cards.number_tooltip: Locations linked to your company brands in this city.
cards.as_of_tooltip: Portfolio records in Vantage, not external POS feeds.
